tagline.zh: 经典三栏(页头/侧栏/主栏/页脚)的现代 Grid 实现:grid-template-areas 一个声明拼出整页骨架,改字符串就能重排——侧栏换边、移动端堆叠都只是换一串空格。
tagline.en: The classic three-column page (header/sidebar/main/footer) done the modern Grid way: grid-template-areas composes the whole skeleton in one declaration, and re-ordering — sidebar to the other side, stacked mobile — is just swapping strings.

origin.zh: CSS Grid + grid-template-areas 是圣杯布局的标准实现(MDN Layout Cookbook 未设 Holy Grail 专页,调研 05§2 已验证检索无此条目,实践中以 grid-template-areas 重排实现):每个字符串生成一行、每个单元格生成一列,同名 token 合并为命名区域,可被 grid-placement 属性引用;MDN 标注 Baseline Widely available(自 2017-10 起,调研 05§2)。经典写法 grid-template-areas: "header header" "sidebar main" "footer footer"。
origin.en: CSS Grid + grid-template-areas is the standard modern implementation of the Holy Grail (the MDN Layout Cookbook has no dedicated Holy Grail page — verified absent in research 05 §2 — and practice implements it via grid-template-areas re-ordering): each string generates one row and each cell one column, same-name tokens merge into a named area referenceable by grid-placement properties; MDN marks it Baseline Widely available (since 2017-10, research 05 §2). The classic string: grid-template-areas: "header header" "sidebar main" "footer footer".

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 重写 grid-template-areas 字符串——该属性的字符串值不保证可走 CSS 变量,demo 按 container-queries 同款惯例以 JS 重生成)。三档:desktop-left "header side" "main side"…;desktop-right 主/侧互换;stacked 单列按 header→main→side→footer 重排。重排零 DOM 改动,纯字符串声明。
effect.en: JS-type param (the demo rewrites the grid-template-areas string — the property's string values are not reliably CSS-variable friendly, so the demo regenerates them, same convention as container-queries). Three modes: desktop-left "header side" "main side"…; desktop-right swaps main/side; stacked re-orders a single column as header→main→side→footer. Zero DOM changes — pure string declarations.

effect.zh: 轨道间距(CSS 型)。16px 为演示基准值(社区常见,未证实);行距与列距共用一个值,骨架的呼吸感全在这一个变量。
effect.en: Track gap (CSS-type). 16px is a demo baseline (community value, unverified); one value covers rows and columns — the skeleton's breathing room lives in this single variable.

effect.zh: 侧栏列宽(CSS 型,grid-template-columns 第一条轨道)。200px 为演示基准值(社区常见,未证实);主栏吃下剩余空间(1fr),侧栏宽度即圣杯的「比例旋钮」。
effect.en: The sidebar column width (CSS-type, the first grid-template-columns track). 200px is a demo baseline (community value, unverified); the main column takes the rest (1fr) — sidebar width is the Holy Grail's proportion knob.

note.zh: grid-template-areas 为 Baseline Widely available 自 2017-10(MDN,调研 05§2)——命名区域字符串、同名 token 合并与 grid-placement 引用全平台可用。
note.en: grid-template-areas is Baseline Widely available since 2017-10 (MDN, research 05 §2) — named-area strings, same-name token merging and grid-placement references work everywhere.

fallback.zh: 不支持 Grid 的极老环境忽略网格声明,header/main/footer 按块级纵排——内容顺序即堆叠顺序,天然可读。更稳的兜底:先写单列 flex/块级布局,再 @supports (grid-template-areas: "a" "b") 叠加三栏网格;命名区域字符串必须矩形(每行 token 数一致),否则整条声明失效——校验字符串是最常见的手误点。
fallback.en: On ancient non-Grid engines the declarations are ignored and header/main/footer stack as blocks — content order IS the stacking order, naturally readable. A sturdier fallback: write the single-column layout first, then add the grid inside @supports (grid-template-areas: "a" "b"); named-area strings must be rectangular (same token count per row) or the whole declaration fails — string validation is the most common typo trap.

use.zh: 文档站/博客/后台的整页骨架:页头 + 侧栏 + 主栏 + 页脚一声明拼装
use.en: Whole-page skeletons for docs/blogs/admins: header + sidebar + main + footer from one declaration

use.zh: 响应式重排:桌面两栏 ⇄ 移动单列只是换一串 grid-template-areas 字符串
use.en: Responsive re-ordering: desktop two-column ⇄ mobile single column is just swapping the grid-template-areas string

use.zh: 侧栏换边(Dir 差异、A/B 实验):desktop-right 档零 DOM 改动
use.en: Sidebar flipping (RTL differences, A/B tests): the desktop-right mode with zero DOM changes

use.zh: 设计系统的页面级布局令牌:骨架即命名区域,组件填格入住
use.en: Page-level layout tokens for design systems: the skeleton is named areas; components check in

avoid.zh: 非矩形的命名区域字符串(每行 token 数不一致)——整条声明失效,先对齐每行格子数
avoid.en: Non-rectangular area strings (mismatched token counts per row) — the whole declaration fails; align cells per row first

avoid.zh: 嵌套层级里的重复命名区域——同名字符串合并成一个大区域,内层组件命名要加前缀隔离
avoid.en: Duplicate area names across nested levels — same-name strings merge into one big area; prefix inner component names

avoid.zh: 轨道尺寸硬编码而区域字符串另写——行高/列宽与 areas 行列数不匹配时布局崩坏,一起维护
avoid.en: Hard-coded track sizes drifting from the area strings — mismatched row/column counts break the layout; maintain them together

avoid.zh: 把动态数量的内容塞进固定区域——命名区域适合固定骨架,条目流交给 auto-fit 网格条目
avoid.en: Pouring dynamic-count content into fixed areas — named areas suit fixed skeletons; item flows belong to the auto-fit grid entry

a11y.zh: 命名区域重排只改视觉位置,DOM 顺序不变——读屏与 Tab 顺序永远按文档流(WCAG 1.3.2);桌面档侧栏在 DOM 中先于主栏时,读屏用户先听到侧栏导航,这是信息架构决策而非副作用,需有意设计;跳转链接(跳到主内容)在侧栏前置的骨架里尤其必要;键盘焦点随 DOM,与视觉区域无关。
a11y.en: Named-area re-ordering changes visual positions only, never DOM order — screen-reader and Tab order always follow the document flow (WCAG 1.3.2); when the sidebar precedes the main column in the DOM, screen-reader users hear sidebar navigation first — an information-architecture decision to make deliberately, not a side effect; a skip-to-main-content link is especially necessary in sidebar-first skeletons; keyboard focus follows the DOM, not the visual areas.

goal.zh: 复刻圣杯布局的现代 Grid 实现:grid-template-areas 拼出 header/sidebar/main/footer 骨架,附三档重排(侧栏左/侧栏右/移动单列)与实时字符串读数,演示「改字符串就重排」。
goal.en: Replicate the modern Grid Holy Grail: grid-template-areas composes the header/sidebar/main/footer skeleton with three re-order modes (sidebar left/right, mobile stacked) and a live string readout demonstrating "re-order by editing the string".

acceptance.zh: grid-template-areas 字符串矩形(每行 token 数一致),同名 token 合并为区域
acceptance.en: grid-template-areas strings are rectangular (equal token counts per row); same-name tokens merge into areas

acceptance.zh: 区域成员用 grid-area: <name> 入座,不使用行/列数字定位
acceptance.en: Area members sit via grid-area: <name>, never numeric row/column placement

acceptance.zh: 三档重排零 DOM 改动,只重写 areas 字符串与列定义
acceptance.en: All three re-order modes change zero DOM — only the areas string and column definition rewrite

acceptance.zh: 轨道尺寸与间距使用参数快照值;主栏 1fr 吃下剩余空间
acceptance.en: Track sizes and gap use the parameter snapshot values; the main column takes the rest with 1fr

acceptance.zh: 窄容器或 stacked 档下骨架退化为单列,内容完整可读
acceptance.en: On narrow containers or the stacked mode the skeleton degrades to one readable column
